scene.title: BFS Exploration of a Simple Graph
scene.summary: Breadth‑first search starts at A, discovers neighbors B and C, then D, and finally E, using a queue to track the frontier.

beats.title: Graph Overview
beats.narration: Here is the graph we will traverse with BFS starting at A.

beats.title: Start at A
beats.narration: BFS begins at node A, marking it visited and adding its neighbors B and C to the queue.

beats.title: Process B
beats.narration: Dequeue B, visit it, and discover D, which is added to the queue.

beats.title: Process C
beats.narration: Dequeue C and visit it; D is already discovered, so no new nodes are added.

beats.title: Finish
beats.narration: Process D (discover E) and then E; all nodes are now visited.
